Job Description: 
 Respiratory Protection Regulatory Engagement Specialist 
 Collaborate with Innovative 3Mers Around the World 
 Choosing where to start and grow your career has a major impact on your professional and personal life, so it’s equally important you know that the company that you choose to work at, and its leaders, will support and guide you. With a wide variety of people, global locations, technologies and products, 3M is a place where you can collaborate with other curious, creative 3Mers.
 This position provides an opportunity to transition from other private, public, government or military experience to a 3M career. 
 The Impact You’ll Make in this Role 
 As a Respiratory Protection Regulatory Engagement Specialist in 3M’s Personal Safety Division (PSD), you will have the opportunity to tap into your curiosity and collaborate with some of the most innovative people around the world.
 You will collaborate with multidisciplinary colleagues around the world to advance respiratory protection standards, regulations, and occupational health and safety (OHS) practices across global markets. You will represent 3M in high-impact regulatory and standards-development activities, engaging with OHS professionals, industry stakeholders, and regulators as a technical thought leader. In this role, you will shape science-based approaches and provide technical leadership.
 Here, you will make an impact by:
 Facilitating the development of science-based performance and selection and use standards for respiratory protection equipment and occupational health and safety, while tracking progress and key milestones.
 Identifying opportunities to advance respirator related health and safety policies and regulations and developing strategies to implement science-based approaches.
 Helping to coach, mentor, develop, and coordinate PSD’s global team of application engineers and regulatory specialists engaged in respiratory protection standards development activities.
 Collaborating with professional associations, educational organizations, public health organizations, and relevant government entities.
 Representing 3M in standards development organizations and related technical committees.
 Collaborating with cross-functional teams to align on PSD’s highest-priority respirator related standards and regulations that support business growth.
 Leading respirator related research to support new technologies and existing products.
 Communicating emerging respiratory protection standards, regulatory, and policy developments to relevant stakeholders and translating their potential implications into actionable business guidance.
 Your Skills and Expertise 
 To set you up for success in this role from day one, 3M is looking for candidates who must have the following qualifications:  
 Bachelor’s degree or higher (completed and verified prior to start)
 Five (5) years of experience with respiratory protection-related occupational health and safety regulations and performance standards in a private, public, government or military environment.
 Additional qualifications that could help you succeed even further in this role include:
 Master’s degree in occupational health and safety, industrial hygiene, public policy, regulatory affairs, or a related scientific or technical discipline.
 Experience representing an organization with regulatory agencies, standards-development organizations, industry associations, policymakers, or government affairs stakeholders.
 Experience conducting or leading applied research in respiratory protection or personal protective equipment.
 Ability to translate complex technical, regulatory, or policy information into clear guidance for diverse audiences.
 Strong communication, influencing, stakeholder-management, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
 Ability to work effectively across cultures, geographies, and global teams.
 Work location: 
 This role follows an on-site working model, requiring the employee to work at least four days a week at the 3M Center in Maplewood, MN or London, Ontario.
 Travel: May include up to 25% domestic and international 
 Relocation Assistance: Is not authorized 
 Must be legally authorized to work in country of employment without sponsorship for employment visa status (e.g., H1B status). 
 Supporting Your Well-being 
 3M offers many programs to help you live your best life – both physically and financially. To ensure competitive pay and benefits, 3M regularly benchmarks with other companies that are comparable in size and scope.

WHO ARE WE?

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company.  We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!



Role Overview:

Evaluation is critical to making progress in scaling intelligence. As models continue to become superhuman in many real-world use cases, we must continue to develop new evaluation techniques that accurately reflect what models are already capable of, as well as set the agenda for what future models should be capable of. In this role, you are responsible for creating these next-generation evaluation methods and infrastructure to measure LLM progress.



Key Responsibilities:

 - Create ambitious new evaluation benchmarks that push the limits of what our models can accomplish.

 - Work on highly cross-functional teams to translate model feedback into trustworthy, repeatable evaluations.

 - Conduct research to advance the state-of-the-art in LLM evaluation methods, including training LLM judges; refining LLM-based data synthesis pipelines; and improving evaluation efficiency.

 - Build scalable and reusable tools for digging into model performance.



Qualifications:

 - You enjoy rapidly building prototypes that demonstrate the boundaries of what LLMs are capable of, and you have developed resources to measure those capabilities.

 - You have spent dozens of hours reviewing complex data and LLM outputs to ensure high data quality.

 - You are obsessive about rigorously measuring AI capabilities, and also about making sure your measurements actually align with the capabilities you care about.

 - You have strong software engineering skills.



Working Location:
This role can be based remotely or from one of our office locations listed on the job description - there is no minimum in-office qualification requirement. We care most about hiring exceptional people regardless of locations, though please check the location listed on the posting for guidance around the core time zone or working hours alignment expected for the role.

 




FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES AT COHERE ENJOY THESE PERKS:

 - A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch.

 - Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health.

 - RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme.

 - 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent.

 - Annual enrichment benefits:
   
   Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit.
   
   Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching.

 - 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!)

 - Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite.




HOW AND WHERE WE WORK:

 - Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon.

 - For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events.

 - For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city.

 - Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly.
   
   

If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply. 


We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12a6IrLdF3kI2nonKSr4tiFuz18rLQbaeYV-JM9L4o9Q/edit, and we will work together to meet your needs.

Location: PHO Corporate Office & Toronto Laboratory, 661 University Avenue, Toronto, ON 
Department: COVID Genomics  
 This posting is to fill a current vacancy.
 The Role: 
To provide technical support for real-time PCR testing within the Virology department and to support the overall Covid response within laboratory operations manual set up of real time PCR to the molecular laboratory and to support laboratory operations for Covid PCR. 
 Key Responsibilities- 
 Under the guidance of a Medical Laboratory Technologist or Molecular Specialist, manual or partially-automated set up of real-time PCR, including preparation of primer and probe stocks, and Sanger sequencing.
 Manual or automated extraction of nucleic acids on high throughput platforms as assigned.
 Operation of real-time thermalcycler, extraction platforms, Sanger sequencing platform, and automated liquid handling platforms.
 Real-time PCR data analysis using vendor thermalcycling software.
 Technical support for validation or evaluation studies under the direction of the manager, team lead, MLT or molecular specialist.
 Handling or processing of human specimens including respiratory specimens, blood, urine is advantageous.
 Prioritizes work and responds to urgent or unpredictable demands.
 Other duties as assigned.
 Knowledge and Skills- 
 Strong understanding molecular theory and best practices including real-time PCR, nucleic acid extraction, molecular workflows, primer and probe dilution calculation and preparation is a strong asset.
 Experience with standard molecular lab applications and instrumentation (e.g. DNA extraction, pipetting, PCR set up, sequencing) an asset.
 Familiarity with general laboratory equipment including centrifuges, incubators, pipettors, automated liquid handlers, incubators, biological safety cabinets.
 Good working understanding of and experience using Microsoft Word, Excel, Access.
 Time management and ability to prioritize.
 Strong written and verbal communication skills.
 High degree of comfort with automation.
 Adaptability to changing demands and willingness to learn.
 Understanding of Sanger sequencing and Next Generation Sequencing theory is an asset.
 Education and Experience- 
 Bachelor of Science.
 Minimum of 6 months of real-time PCR, preferably in a clinical genetics or molecular genetics laboratory.
 Attributes and Competencies- 
 Works within established procedures for a Medical Laboratory Assistant and within PHO Lab standards and protocols.
 Follows technical instructions (SOP) for testing of samples and preparation of reagents.
 Solves basic problems (e.g., mismatched samples, issues with prepared media such as incorrect pH).
 Seeks advice and direction in solving more complex problems.
 Determines which organisms can/cannot be handled due to safety/risk.
 May be required to lift up to 10 kg..
 May be required to work within a biological safety cabinet/fumehood.
 Physical coordination and manual dexterity in the use of keyboard, operate and maintain laboratory equipment, and perform testing of specimens.
 May be required to perform repetitive tasks such as pipetting.
 May be required to stand or sit for the period of one shift.
 Requires physical activity such as walking, lifting, stretching and bending.
 May be required to work shifts as scheduled.
 Works within a Laboratory environment which contains hazardous and infectious materials, odors, noise generated from automated analyzers, some temperature extremes, such as walk in fridges and freezers.
 Required to adhere to Laboratory safety including proper use of biological safety cabinets, autoclaves and personal protective equipment.
 Works shifts as assigned.

About Moment Energy 
 Independent energy is here. Help us deploy it. 
 Energy should be free. Free from aging grids, fragile supply chains, and unnecessary extraction. At Moment Energy, we’re building a world where clean power is abundant, affordable, and uninterrupted for everyone. 
 The world doesn’t need another promise about energy; it needs proof that a freer future is possible. Moment Energy is the pragmatic liberator of power, the only company certified to turn the largest untapped energy supply into independent energy. 
 Now is the moment. While the industry scraps millions of batteries with decades of life left, we put them to work by repurposing large-format batteries into advanced battery energy storage systems that deliver real-world impact. 
 We were told second-life batteries would never be safe enough or scalable enough. We didn’t argue, we engineered the solution. Today, Moment Energy delivers 5x the energy density and holds the certifications required to deploy energy independence at scale. 
 Now is the moment. Join us. 
 The Opportunity 
 The Executive Assistant will play a critical role in supporting Moment Energy’s Chief Product Officer (CPO), who leads our Sales, Business Development, and Marketing efforts. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment and enjoys helping senior leaders stay organized, focused, and effective. 
 The ideal candidate has outstanding interpersonal skills, a positive can-do attitude, strong initiative, sound judgment, and the ability to manage confidential information with discretion. This role requires someone who can juggle multiple priorities, communicate across teams, and ensure that key commercial initiatives stay organized and on track. Critical thinking skills are crucial for this role! If you need to be hand-held and given detailed instructions to get tasks done, this is not the job for you. 
 This is a highly visible position that offers exposure to strategic business conversations, external partnerships, and the operational side of scaling a clean energy company. 
 Responsibilities and Duties 
 Executive Support 
 Provide high-level administrative support to the Chief Product Officer and VP of Business Development. 
 Manage complex calendars, schedule internal and external meetings, and coordinate meeting logistics. 
 Prepare meeting agendas, capture notes, and track follow-up actions. 
 Coordinate domestic and international travel arrangements as required. 
 Prepare and submit expense reports on behalf of the CPO and VP. 
 Support logistics for visitors, partners, or events involving the executive team when required. 
 Commercial & Strategic Support 
 Assist with preparation of presentations, reports, and materials for customers, partners, and internal leadership meetings. 
 Support organization of sales, business development, and marketing initiatives by tracking priorities, timelines, and deliverables. 
 Assist with preparing investor or partner updates related to commercial growth and partnerships. 
 Cross-Functional Coordination 
 Act as a liaison between Sales, Business Development, Marketing, and other internal teams to help ensure alignment and follow-through on key initiatives. 
 Coordinate internal meetings related to partnerships, customers, and go-to-market initiatives. 
 Help ensure important documents, presentations, and resources are organized and accessible. 
 Operations & Administration 
 Create, edit, and organize documents such as reports, presentations, and research summaries. 
 Help track budgets, expenses, and key operational documents as needed. 
 Maintain organization of key business records and confidential documents. 
 Support organization of executive meetings, partner visits, and company events. 
 Assist with special projects and ad-hoc tasks as needed. 
 The Candidate 
 We’re looking for individuals with the following traits, skills, and experiences: 
 Bachelor’s degree in Business, Communications, Marketing, or a related field. 
 3+ years of experience supporting leadership teams. 
 Exceptional written and verbal communication skills. 
 Highly organized and detail-oriented with strong time-management abilities. 
 Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. 
 Comfortable working independently while collaborating with cross-functional teams. 
 Tech-savvy and familiar with tools such as Google Workspace, project management tools, and presentation software. 
 Strong professionalism and ability to handle confidential information with discretion. 
 A proactive mindset with the ability to anticipate needs and solve problems before they arise. 
 Why join us? 
 Today, we’re delivering 5x the energy density and have all the certifications needed to ship energy independence to the world. 
 Be part of a mission-driven company focused on creating sustainable energy solutions and making a positive impact on the world. 
 Collaborate closely with passionate co-founders and a team committed to innovation and excellence. 
 Contribute to building and scaling a company from the ground up, where your work will have a direct and meaningful impact. 
 Thrive in a workplace that values collaboration, wellness, and celebrating successes, with regular company socials, fitness sessions, and more. 
 We're a fast-paced and dynamic team. 
 Every day you'll be taking on a new challenge and learning something new. You'll take on a wide breadth of tasks and contribute to disrupting the battery industry. You'll be part of a tight-knit team that is working together to save the planet! Fun, health, and wellness are incorporated into our daily schedule and we encourage all our team members to bring innovative ideas to the table to create an interactive workplace. 
 Moment Energy Benefits Highlights (full time, permanent employees only) 
 Financial Growth: Employee equity and a robust RRSP matching program. 
 Comprehensive Health Coverage: Extended health, dental, and vision benefits for you and your dependents through Manulife.
 Generous Time Off & Flexibility: Paid time off plus a paid company closure between Christmas and New Year's, with a generous paid sick leave.
 Vibrant Culture & Perks: Open and collaborative office culture, frequent company socials and wellness programs (weekly yoga/fitness), and free EV charging on-site.
 Company Dinner: Weekly Tuesday dinner provided by Moment Energy. We also have a generous supply of coffee and snacks for the office! 
 Our Commitments 
 Moment Energy is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to inclusive, barrier-free recruitment and selection processes, including our work environment. We especially welcome applications from Indigenous peoples, members of racialized communities, persons with disabilities, women, and persons who identify as 2SLGBTQ+. 
 —--- 
 Our Values 
 Our values are key to how we show up every day at Moment Energy! We keep them in the forefront of what we do, and they’re used everywhere. We refer to them when we have tough decisions to make, we give shoutouts based on living out these values, and we include them as part of our performance reviews. 
 We have 5 core values and 1 foundational pillar (Safety is our Foundation) which lays the groundwork for everything we do. 
 Safety is our Foundation 
 We prioritize the safety of our products, customers, employees, and the general public above all else. From the workshop to the field, we maintain the highest standards for our batteries in testing manufacturing and deployment, and daily operations. Safety is not only about procedures—it is about vigilance, responsibility, and speaking up when something does not feel right. 
 Safety is everyone's responsibility. We follow safety protocols, use proper equipment, and continuously improve our systems to prevent risks before they occur. If something is unsafe, we stop work and address it. 
 Safety also means protecting our colleagues, customers, and communities by designing reliable products, maintaining safe workspaces, and ensuring our work is done carefully and responsibly. 
 We’re Building a Greener Future Together: 
 We infuse passion for our cleantech mission into every aspect of our work and incorporate fun into the workplace. We motivate one another, celebrate our successes and embrace eco-friendly practices to reduce our carbon footprint. 
 We Prioritize our Customer’s Needs: 
 We place our customers at the core of everything we do, ensuring that every decision considers their needs and aims to provide increased value to them. We provide reliable support for our customers, every step of the way. 
 We’re Open, Honest and Accountable: 
 We prioritize open and honest communication to foster mutual understanding, strengthen knowledge sharing, and reduce miscommunication within the team. We admit when we’ve made a mistake, and remedy our actions. We transparently communicate outcomes whether good, bad, or unexpected. 
 We Think and Act like Owners: 
 We’re self-starters that proactively embrace new challenges along with personal and collective ownership of responsibilities in the organization. We focus on growth, not titles, and we do what needs to be done. 
 We Treat Everyone with Respect: 
 We actively listen, share openly, and work together towards common goals. We treat one another with mutual respect to cultivate an inclusive environment where everyone feels accepted, supported, and heard. We keep an open mind and are willing to learn.

About the company 
 Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. This is a task-based, independent contractor opportunity, not an employment relationship. Participation is limited to this project.
 Project Highlights 
 Earnings per approved task: a fixed rate for each task, set in advance
 Fully self-scheduled: no minimum hours and no set schedule; you choose which tasks to take and when
 Remote: open to US-licensed physicians based in eligible US states
 No patient contact, no malpractice exposure: you review written clinical cases
 All contributors are license-verified physicians
 $50 one-time onboarding reward, paid once your first task on the project is approved
 What this project involves 
 We're looking for physicians (MD/DO) with an active, unrestricted US medical license to evaluate clinical EHR vignettes for a medical AI evaluation project. General and internal medicine are the main focus. Each task is a written clinical case, assessed against the project's acceptance criteria. Contributors may:
 Evaluate clinical EHR vignettes paired with a question, a proposed answer, and a distractor "trap" answer across diagnosis and treatment tasks, spanning cardiovascular, nervous, hematologic, respiratory, digestive, urinary, reproductive, musculoskeletal, and integumentary systems;
 Score the clinical reasoning quality of benchmark items: vignette accuracy and completeness, whether the vignette gives the answer away, answer correctness and gradeability, and trap quality;
 Check whether the reasoning chain reaches the answer from vignette facts alone, correct reasoning traces, and write short rationales.
 Each case receives three independent blind reads, followed by physician adjudication. Real clinical complexity only. You're improving the AI tools you'll eventually use yourself.
 What we look for 
 This project is a good fit for US-licensed physicians looking for a flexible, time-limited project they can fit around their other commitments. Ideally, contributors will have:
 Medical degree (MD or DO) and an active, unrestricted US medical license (verified at onboarding and re-checked monthly);
 Board certification or completed residency training, with direct patient care experience (attending-level preferred). Practising or retired physicians welcome;
 Broad, multi-system diagnostic and treatment experience (internal, family, emergency, or hospital medicine);
 Strong clinical reasoning: differential diagnosis, next-step management, and application of evidence-based guidelines;
 Prior experience in medical AI evaluation, clinical content or exam-question review, or medical annotation/QA (a plus);
 Strong written English (C1+).
 This project is not suitable for medical students, unlicensed medical graduates, non-physician clinicians (NPs, PAs, nurses, pharmacists), or non-clinical healthcare titles.
 How it works 
 Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join the project → Complete tasks → Get paid for approved tasks
 Flexibility 
 You decide whether, when, and how much to contribute. There are no minimum hours, set schedules, or required availability. Task availability varies with project phases. Tasks are submitted through the platform and are approved when they meet the project’s acceptance criteria.
 Earnings 
 Earnings are paid only for completed and approved tasks. Each task type has a fixed rate. There is no time tracking and no hour logging. There are no tiers or speed adjustments to the rate. QA and adjudication tasks have a higher per-task rate.
 $50 one-time onboarding reward, paid once your first task on the project is approved.
 Quality incentives: additional earnings for high-quality approved tasks, on terms set out in the project guidelines.

About Foundation
 Foundation helps B2B tech and SaaS brands get found, cited and recommended when their buyers ask AI for solutions. We do it through Generative Engine Optimization (GEO): the research, content, distribution and optimization that build a brand's presence across LLMs, search, Reddit, YouTube and the sources they draw on.
 The role
 You lead a smaller team: 2–4 people delivering for a book of up to $1.5M, or a specialist team such as Paid or Video. You spend about half your time doing the strategy or channel work yourself and the rest leading the team: the plan, the people and the client's day-to-day.
 This is the role AEO Program Directors grow from.
 On our enterprise accounts, AEO Program Directors lead the dedicated team that delivers the work: the plan, the people and the quality. AEO Marketing Directors own the client relationship, the strategic roadmap and the account's growth. You're client-facing every week, and the key relationship, renewals and expansions sit with the AEO Marketing Director.
 Reports to: a Group AEO Marketing Director or Client Services leadership. Team: 2–4 direct reports.
 What you'll own
 The delivery plan for each client on your team, and hitting its dates.
 Hands-on work on your most important clients, about half your time.
 Your team's day-to-day: priorities, coaching and first review of their work.
 Effort estimates for new and changed scope.
 The client's working team: status calls and working sessions.
 What you bring
 5+ years in agency strategy, channel delivery or client services, with some experience leading people or projects.
 Deep skill in at least one channel, such as SEO and GEO, paid media, Reddit or YouTube.
 Experience running several client programs at once.
 Working knowledge of how AI search is changing B2B buyer discovery.
 Compensation
 Base salary $88k–$110k depending on experience and location
 Variable compensation: Target 10% of base, paid quarterly on team margin, client retention and delivery quality. Where you land in the range depends on experience. US ranges may be adjusted for cost of labor in your state. Benefits are on top of base.

 Experience in financial services or another large, matrixed organization is preferred.

 Strong judgment, intellectual curiosity and comfort operating in ambiguous, fast-moving and highly visible situations.
 Ability to work effectively with senior executives and build alignment across stakeholders with different perspectives and priorities.
 Advanced PowerPoint and Excel capabilities, including experience developing executive-level presentations and analytical models. Experience with other analytical tools or dashboards is an asset.

Auto Electric Service Ltd. is seeking a Vice President of Product to lead one of the most important functions in our next stage of growth.
 Founded in 1943, AES is a locally owned Saskatchewan wholesale distribution company serving the automotive aftermarket, agriculture, industrial, heavy-duty, PBE, commercial paint, retail, OEM dealer, jobber, and service markets across Southern Saskatchewan. We are investing heavily in our Distribution Centre, inventory capabilities, technology, people, and systems as we build toward our long-term growth strategy. 
 This is not simply a purchasing role.
 The VP of Product will have executive accountability for Product Assortment, Inventory Strategy, Purchasing, Pricing, Category Management, and Product-related Technology and Analytics .
 The Opportunity 
 The VP of Product will answer some of the most important commercial questions in our business:
 What should we sell?
 What should we stock, where, and how much?
 Which suppliers and product lines should we grow?
 How should we price by market, category, and customer?
 Where should we enter new categories?
 How can data and technology improve these decisions?
 The mission is to build a disciplined, accountable, technology-enabled Product function that delivers broad product availability while improving inventory productivity, contribution margin, GMROI, and return on invested capital. 
 Key Outcomes 
 Build a Smarter Inventory Network
 Lead AES’s enterprise-wide inventory strategy across our Distribution Centre and branch network. Improve fill rates and product availability while reducing excess, obsolete, and unproductive inventory.
 Grow and Optimize the Product Assortment
 Identify assortment gaps, rationalize underperforming SKUs, evaluate new categories, and ensure our product mix reflects actual customer and market demand across Automotive, Agriculture, Industrial, Heavy Duty, and PBE. 
 Lead Pricing Strategy
 Drive the continued evolution from traditional cost-plus pricing toward more data-driven, market-aware pricing designed to improve contribution margin while maintaining competitiveness. 
 Elevate Purchasing
 Transform purchasing into a more strategic, analytical function. Strengthen vendor relationships, improve supplier accountability, negotiate stronger commercial programs, and align purchasing decisions with demand, inventory, and financial outcomes. 
 Build a Disciplined New Product Process
 Ensure new product lines and categories are supported by clear business cases, expected ROI, required inventory investment, launch plans, and post-launch accountability.
 Use Data and Technology as a Competitive Advantage
 Work with internal and external technology partners to improve pricing, demand forecasting, product recommendations, customer insights, inventory positioning, and master data. 
 Build the Team and Function
 Develop the structure, people, processes, scorecards, and operating rhythms required to support AES’s growth. Participate as an active member of the Senior Leadership Team and work cross-functionally with Sales, Operations, Logistics, Finance, Marketing, and Technology. 
 What You Bring
 We are looking for a commercially minded, analytical leader who understands the connection between product, inventory, pricing, purchasing, data, and customer demand .
 The ideal candidate will bring:
 8+ years of progressive senior leadership experience in product management, category management, purchasing, pricing, commercial analytics, supply chain, or a related function.
 Proven experience managing significant inventory portfolios and improving inventory productivity, profitability, and GMROI.
 Strong commercial and financial acumen, with experience in pricing strategy, supplier negotiations, category management, and demand forecasting.
 Experience using ERP, BI, pricing, inventory, analytics, or other business technology platforms to support decision-making.
 Experience developing or improving pricing, forecasting, predictive analytics, or other data-driven business tools.
 Proven ability to lead teams, manage cross-functional initiatives, and turn complex information into clear business decisions.
 Experience in wholesale distribution, automotive aftermarket, agriculture, industrial, heavy-duty, or PBE is highly desirable.
 Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain Management, Data Analytics, Engineering, Finance, or a related field; MBA or advanced credentials are an asset.
 What Success Looks Like
 Success means building a disciplined, data-driven Product organization that provides customers with broad, reliable local product availability while managing inventory and working capital effectively.
 Our purchasing becomes more strategic, supplier performance is measurable, pricing decisions are increasingly data-driven, and new product opportunities are supported by strong business cases. Our teams have better tools and information to make decisions and serve customers.
 Ultimately, the Product function becomes a key driver of profitable growth, inventory productivity, and customer value as AES continues to scale. A full job description is available by request for interested candidates.
 Why Work With Us 
 At Auto Electric Service Ltd., we are in an exciting phase of business growth and expansion. This is an opportunity to join a company that is investing in its future and strengthening its presence within Saskatchewan communities.
 We offer a supportive, team-focused environment where employees are empowered to contribute directly to business growth and build meaningful customer relationships.
 Benefits include: 
 • Competitive salary with performance-based bonuses
 • Comprehensive health and dental insurance
 • Life and disability insurance
 • Company pension plan
 • Employee discounts
 • Flexible scheduling for work-life balance
 • Paid time off and holiday pay
 • Training and development opportunities
 Location: Regina, Saskatchewan
 Travel: Limited
 If you are energized by the opportunity to build, lead, and transform a critical function inside a growing Saskatchewan company, we would like to hear from you.

WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

 ONLINE INFRASTRUCTURE
 What We Do 
 We enable Epic’s online services teams to build, deploy, and manage services that are used by more than half a billion players around the world. Our mission is to provide world class tools and platforms to improve the experience of our developers and make it easier, faster, and safer to build, operate, and scale their applications. We operate at massive scale as one of the largest cloud computing users in the world.
 What You'll Do 
 You'll be the senior technical voice across Epic's developer platform: the source control, CI/CD, build, artifact, database and cloud infrastructure that teams across Epic use to build and ship their work. You'll look at problems across systems and teams, and set the technical strategy for where the platform needs to go. The primary focus of this role is rebuilding and scaling our systems to handle millions of agentic CICD actions per day. You'll work across teams to understand their requirements and usage patterns, negotiate trade-offs with cost and feasibility in mind, and build and deploy the changes needed. Beyond that, this is a role for someone we can point at a hard, ambiguous problem in any domain or team and trust to understand it, decide what to do, and get it solved, whether that means designing the system and building it yourself, or bringing the right people together.  Write clear strategy documents, design proposals and decision records that leadership and programmers can act on

 Strong understanding of software supply chain and infrastructure security, and experience working with security and governance teams
 A track record of leading cross-team technical initiatives from an ambiguous problem through to delivered results

 The Role 
 BeyondTrust is seeking a Senior Staff Software Development Engineer to set the technical direction for NHI Governance. NHI Governance is the Pathfinder Insights module that discovers, assesses, and remediates non-human identities — service principals, IAM users, access keys and secrets, workload identities, and AI agents — across Microsoft Entra ID, AWS, and on-premise environments. The system spans .NET 10 services over PostgreSQL; an inventory pipeline fed from governed Databricks lakehouse views; durable Temporal workflows (Python workers, a .NET gateway, protobuf contracts) that onboard, rotate, reduce access for, and decommission live customer credentials, with custody in BeyondTrust Password Safe and storage adapters for AWS Secrets Manager, Azure Key Vault, and HashiCorp Vault; and Angular micro-frontends in the Insights console. It ships through GitOps to Amazon EKS in commercial and government environments.
 As one of the most senior engineers on the team, you will own the architecture across these pieces and the contracts that hold them together, lead the system from prototype to hardened production, and act as a force multiplier for a team that works in an AI-assisted, agent-native way.
 What You’ll Do 
 Own end-to-end architecture for NHI Governance across its services, the workflow layer it shares with the platform team, and the data lineage from the Insights lakehouse — and decide where each boundary lives.
 Design the source and vault plug-in seams (today Entra and AWS are bespoke), so a new identity source or vault becomes a repeatable, conformance-tested addition rather than a rewrite.
 Define and evolve the contracts other teams build on: service APIs and protobuf workflow schemas with breaking-change gates.
 Set the safety model for credential-lifecycle automation — rotation, decommissioning, access reduction, approvals, compensation, and points of no return — where a defect can revoke a customer's production credential.
 Define the least-privilege permission model customers grant us in Entra ID, AWS, and Password Safe, feature by feature. Own how it is verified live and explained in the product, and the setup assets (scripts, templates) that grant exactly that and no more.
 Lead the path from prototype to production: service-to-service authentication, tenant isolation, FIPS-compliant builds, and promotion through commercial and government environments.
 Design how our own services obtain identities and secrets across AWS accounts, regions, and environments — least privilege, workload identity, no long-lived keys.
 Partner with product, platform, data, and security leaders to align technical strategy with the roadmap; make the build/buy and architectural trade-off calls.
 Raise how the team builds: design reviews, testing against real dependencies and live test tenants, and the conventions and guardrails for AI-assisted development.
 Mentor staff and senior engineers and grow technical leadership on the team.
 What You’ll Bring 
 Deep expertise architecting and operating large-scale, multi-tenant, distributed cloud services, with a track record of owning architecture across multiple teams or an entire domain.
 Expert in C#/.NET, plus working proficiency in Python — our Temporal workers and every activity that touches a credential are Python. (Equivalent depth in another typed backend language is fine if you can lead a .NET codebase.)
 Production experience with durable or long-running workflow orchestration (e.g., Temporal, AWS Step Functions, Durable Functions) and event-driven systems (e.g., Kafka) — idempotency, retries, compensation, and workflow versioning.
 Hands-on experience building or operating systems that create, rotate, or revoke credentials — cloud access keys, service principals and app registrations, certificates, or vault-held secrets — and a sound instinct for blast radius.
 PAM or vault platform integration experience: managed accounts, rotation plugins, functional accounts. BeyondTrust Password Safe a plus.
 AWS at design level: you have designed how services obtain identity and secrets in production across multiple accounts and environments — least-privilege IAM, workload identity (e.g., IRSA or OIDC federation) instead of long-lived keys, Secrets Manager and KMS, and infrastructure as code (Terraform/Terragrunt).
 Azure at working level: Microsoft Entra ID app registrations and service principals, Microsoft Graph permissions and admin consent, managed identities, and Key Vault.
 Experience defining and versioning API and schema contracts (OpenAPI, protobuf) consumed by multiple teams.
 Production familiarity with Kubernetes (EKS preferred) and GitOps delivery.
 Excellent communication; able to influence technical direction across teams and with leadership.
 Comfortable working in an AI-assisted codebase and setting the standard for how AI-generated code is reviewed — especially changes that touch permissions.
 Nice To Have 
 Deep identity-security domain experience: IAM, NHI and secrets management, OAuth/OIDC, privileged access management.
 Delivery in regulated or government environments (FedRAMP, FIPS 140, AWS GovCloud).
 Additional identity models (GCP service accounts, GitHub Apps and tokens, Okta).
 Lakehouse / Databricks pipelines, including row-level security and governed data access; graph data modeling.
 Service mesh and mTLS.
 Daily hands-on practice with agentic coding tools such as Claude Code.
 Taking a module from 0 to 1 at enterprise scale.
 Who You Are 
 A technical authority who takes ownership of the hardest problems and delivers scalable, safe solutions.
 A force multiplier who elevates the engineers and teams around you.
 Someone who balances technical excellence with pragmatic decision-making, ensuring security without unnecessary complexity.
 A strong communicator and influencer across technical and business audiences.
